authoring.author: claude (de-baarsjes-faces lane)
authoring.note: Jan Evertsenstraat 94-142 (even side, Mercatorplein to the passage). The hood-lisene row 96-140 (evertsen-1926-hood-lisene): box frames by the lisenes on every other party wall, the party-wall windows completed by mirrored neighbours, the glass-block band over the canopy; the 94 corner with its stair tower and the red-brick 142. Re-intaked from 142 (the Mercatorplein clock tower 107349 is its own landmark).
